== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The later slip removes the need for another Ewok to protect Chief Chirpa and removes the Hut’s battle-damage protection. It restates how Ewok Catapult can apply to a non-Dark Jedi instead of an armored vehicle.
